component.name: BachelorPad+
component.summary: Text editor for notes, data and logs

description.p: BachelorPad+ is a plain-text editor that starts as fast as Notepad and stays out of the way: open a file, change it, save it.

It reads plain text, logs, Markdown, JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV and XML, keeps a recovery journal so unsaved work survives a crash, and can save a document encrypted with a passphrase in its own .bpadx format.
